Top Story

Netanyahu Calls For Escalation Of Iran War In Plea For Unity Government With Eisenkot

Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu urged electoral rival Eisenkot to form a national unity government with him, warning that any other potential governing coalition would be too weak to tackle the "existential threat" posed by an allegedly emboldened Iran.
  • Israeli Intelligence Chief Visits Washington At Tense Juncture In U.S.-Iran War. Oil Prices Could Increase.
  • Trump Said Striking Iran Is 'Highly Unlikely' Now. But Rubio Is Casting Doubt On An Agreement.
  • Israel's President Says He Has Chosen Eisenkot To Form The Next Government, But That May Not End The Uncertainty
  • Netanyahu Sought to Conduct an Operation in Iran Before Israel's Elections But Was Stopped by the U.S.: Report

  • AI Poses Biggest Threat To Financial System And Wider Global Economy: Fed Survey

    A Federal Reserve survey found that 87% of respondents view AI as a significant risk to U.S. and global financial stability, a marked increase compared to the 50% who said the same thing in spring.

  • Washington Mooted Ukrainian Membership Of NATO In Exchange For Territorial Concessions: Zelenskyy

    Volodymyr Zelenskyy says U.S. officials suggested Ukraine withdraw from Donbas in exchange for NATO membership, while Kyiv maintains it would not legally recognize any occupied territories as Russian.

  • FAA Lifts Nationwide Ground Stop After Hourslong Shutdown. Duffy Blames Aging Technology.

    Overloaded routers and aging air traffic control equipment reportedly triggered the rare nationwide shutdown. Officials ruled out no possibilities but said there was no indication of a cyberattack.

  • US Moves To Counter China's $1.3 Billion Megaport In Peru. A New Battle For Pacific Trade Emerges

    Two ports less than 50 miles apart are becoming a focal point of U.S.-China competition over maritime infrastructure, trade routes and strategic influence in Latin America.

  • UN Nuclear Watchdog Cannot Verify Iran's Underground Nuclear Plant. 441 Kg Uranium Stockpile In Question.

    The latest findings come as Trump rules out the need for a nuclear deal with Tehran, while Iranian officials reject proposals to transfer enriched uranium abroad.
Latest News

  • Democrat Ro Khanna Is Considering A Presidential Bid. He Could Be The Progressive Wing's Candidate.

  • China Quietly Mobilizes Over 100 Warships And Patrol Vessels. Is Beijing Rehearsing A Taiwan Blockade?

  • Democrat Peltola Closes In On Alaska Senate Seat. She Is Already Claiming Victory.

  • Italy Fines Meta Nearly $1 Billion Over Company Accessing User Photos And Videos 'Without Consent'

  • US Household Debt Jumps $166 Billion As Quarterly Increase Surges 131% From 2025

  • Oil Tanker Capsizes Cruise Ship Carrying 129 Passengers In New Orleans. 32 Taken To Hospitals.

  • Microsoft Outage Disrupts Work Across The Globe. Nearly 20,000 Problems Reported Per Minute At Peak.

  • US Army Officer Arrested In Russia Espionage Probe. He Was Stationed At NATO Headquarters

  • Hakeem Jeffries Won't Rule Out Investigating Elon Musk As Democrats Take Control Of Congress

  • Who Is Colette Kress, Nvidia's New Interim CEO? Finance Veteran Takes Over After Jensen Huang's Resignation.

THE BOTTOM LINE

New Study Finds An Immigration Bond In Denver Was More Than 13 Times The Median In Bloomington

New TRAC court data show wide differences in bond amounts while emphasizing that local medians do not explain individual cases or custody decisions.
  • Social Media Companies Continue To Settle Lawsuits For Millions. More Than 9,000 Cases Are Pending.
  • Wall Street Slides As Chip Stocks Extend Selloff. Nasdaq Takes Biggest Hit Despite Cooler Inflation.
Visionary Voices

  • Why This Gen Z Tech CEO Says the Future Belongs to Generation Alpha

  • Medium CEO Tony Stubblebine on Why AI Could Kill the Creator Economy

  • Larry Sharpe on What Replaced the American Dream: "The Empire Is Falling"

Press Release

  • STARPRIME Collaborates with HedgX to Expand Institutional Risk and Dealing Capabilities

  • Rantizo (Nasdaq: RNTZ) Advances U.S. Production of Heavy-Lift Autonomous Drones After $258.8 Million Acquisition, Targets California’s $61.2 Billion Agricultural Market

  • S&P Upgrades Freedom Finance Insurance to ‘BB’ as Market Position Strengthens

Economy in Focus

  • US Wholesale Inflation Hits Four-Year High At 6.5%. Fed Faces Pressure Over December Rate Hike.

    U.S. wholesale prices rose 6.5% over the 12 months through October, the highest increase since 2022, adding to inflation concerns ahead of the Federal Reserve's December meeting.
    • Inflation Stays Hot: 3 Financial Stocks to Watch as Fed Rate Risks Rise
    • Bitcoin Falls Below $70,000. Strategy Faces New Pressure After MSCI Exclusion.
    • The States Leading Household Debt Increases As U.S. Total Tops $19 Trillion

  • The States Leading Household Debt Increases As U.S. Total Tops $19 Trillion

    Hawaii households added an average of $2,216 in debt during the third quarter, compared with $648 in Mississippi, the smallest increase nationwide.
    • A Fed Governor Called The Latest Inflation Data 'Borderline Disturbing.' A Half-Point Hike Is Now Firmly On The Table.
    • Nearly Half Of Americans Say They've Sold Something Or Expect To Do It To Help Pay For The Holidays
Editor's pick

  • 94 Private Jet Flights, 777 Tons of CO2. The Irony at Turkey's UN Climate Summit

  • Supreme Court Agrees To Consider Robinhood's Request To Drop IPO Lawsuit

  • Trump's Deportations Hit ICE Record as Most Voters Say Enforcement Went Too Far

  • FAA Grounds All Departing Flights Across America. Nationwide Air Traffic Control Failure Sparks Rare Shutdown.

  • Uber Drivers' License Details Stolen in Major Data Breach. Thousands Affected Across US.

  • Bessent Calls Out Commerce Over Megaspeed Scandal as Nvidia Faces Congressional Scrutiny

CRYPTO BLOCK

Bitcoin Falls Below $70,000. Strategy Faces New Pressure After MSCI Exclusion.

Michael Saylor's company faces potential selling by index-tracking funds, with billions in additional outflows possible if other benchmark providers follow MSCI.

  • Crypto Groups Spent $63 Million To Stop Sherrod Brown. Ohio Voters Sent Him Back To The Senate.

Contributor

How Personal AI's Miroslav Volek Is Moving AI Into the Telecom Network

Personal AI engineering chief Miroslav Volek is developing distributed AI infrastructure for telecom networks, including voice systems designed to improve response times and reduce compute costs.
  • Contributor

    Jeff Lontoc Is Challenging the Traditional Management Consulting Model

    Daloy founder Jeff Lontoc explains how AI can speed up consulting while human expertise, process analysis, and business context remain essential to delivering results.
  • Contributor

    Why Employee Benefits Need a New Operating Model

    KFF's 2026 survey finds family health premiums rose 5% to $28,303, while worker contributions jumped 9% to $7,471, fueling demand for simpler benefits.

IBT Spotlight

We Help Businesses Find B2B Service Providers They Can Trust.

Get Listed

  • Cerebras Stock Surges After Microsoft Deal. Can The AI Chipmaker Sustain Its Growth?

  • Americans Are Spending $700 Billion On Wellness. Even Everyday Products Are Getting A Health Makeover.

U.S.

  • The States Where A College Education Puts The Biggest Strain On Family Budgets

    WalletHub found that annual college costs consume the largest share of median household income in Rhode Island and the smallest in Utah, based on a comparison of 48 states.

  • Over 7 In 10 Americans Want Congress To End The Iran War. Half Of Republicans Agree.

  • Waymo's Driverless Cars Have A School Bus Problem. Nearly 2,900 Robotaxis Are Now Under Federal Scrutiny.

World

  • Israeli Intelligence Chief Visits Washington At Tense Juncture In U.S.-Iran War. Oil Prices Could Increase.

    Mossad Director Roman Gofman is reportedly meeting U.S. officials as tensions with Iran persist, while Israeli pressure, Gulf incidents and rising oil prices fuel concerns about escalation.

  • U.S.-Mediated Talks Between Russia And Ukraine Produced No Breakthrough. Moscow Reportedly Made Several Demands Of Europe.

  • US Denies Iran's Claim Of Radar Strike In Bahrain. Says Two Drones Were Shot Down.

Politics

  • Trump Wants To Get Cuba 'Done' Before He Leaves Office. Says Rubio Would Be His Man There.

  • Nvidia Scandal Draws Congress Into China Chip Probe. Lutnick Agrees to Testify.

  • Van Hollen Will Challenge Chuck Schumer For Senate Majority Leader, Deepening Rifts In The Democratic Party

  • 'I Would Pick Marco Rubio.' Florida State Senator Discusses Direction Of GOP Post-Midterms: Exclusive

Technology

  • Samsung in Talks to Buy Modine as Data Center Cooling Stock Surges 29%

    No deal has been finalized, but a potential multibillion-dollar transaction sent Modine shares sharply higher as investors assessed Samsung's push into data center thermal infrastructure.
